rationale: Vega is a well-funded scaling company whose new CMO came from Cortex and Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and is defining a 'post-SIEM' category, so AI visibility in the SIEM and AI SOC categories is squarely his problem. The audit's strongest, most concrete hooks are the near-total absence from unprompted category answers (zero in AI SOC), comparison losses that rest on wrong descriptions rather than real limits, and the brand collision where another Vega's DPA produces a 'No' on zero data retention, a vendor-risk answer he would want to fix. The opener uses this week's award credited to his team, and the bridge reuses his own words from the hire release. The email body is about 180 words by a strict count (numbers included), close to the Bay reference. scott@vega.io is inferred from the first-name pattern (eli@vega.io is published on trust.vega.io); verify with Hunter before sending. Fallback: CEO Shay Sandler.
